senses.gloss: उ॑ल्मुक n. (Uṇ. iii, 84) a firebrand, a piece of burning charcoal used for kindling a fire, ŚBr.; AitBr.; KātyŚr.; ĀśvGṛ. &c.
उ॑ल्मुक m. N. of a son of a Bala-rāma, MBh.; Hariv.
of a son of Manu Cākṣuṣa, VP.
उल्मुक—मथ्य᳙ mfn. to be produced out of a firebrand (as fire), ŚBr. xii, 4, 3, 3.
उल्मुक्या mfn. coming from or produced out of a firebrand (as fire), ŚBr. xii.
